readme:
🎮 SpinHook: A Hyper-Casual Orbit Arcade Game


## Overview **SpinHook** is a fast-paced hyper-casual arcade game built with Phaser 3. Launch from one rotating orbit to another with perfect timing. Each successful hook increases your score while the game gradually becomes more challenging. Easy to learn but difficult to master, SpinHook rewards precision, rhythm, and quick decision-making. 🌐 **Live Game:** [https://spinhook.ir](https://spinhook.ir)
Code Quality
## Features - Endless arcade gameplay - One-touch controls - Procedurally generated orbit layouts - Increasing difficulty - Mobile and desktop support - Leaderboard - Smooth camera movement - Neon-inspired visuals - Built with Phaser 3 ## How to Play 1. Press **Play**. 2. Your hook rotates around the current orbit. 3. Click or tap to launch. 4. Reach the next rotating orbit. 5. Continue hooking from orbit to orbit. 6. Missing the next orbit ends the game. ## Local Development To test SpinHook locally, you can use [Ghps](https://github.com/sepandhaghighi/ghps) a minimal GitHub Pages simulator written in pure Python. Run: ```console ghps --port 5004 ``` Then open your browser and visit: ```console http://localhost:5004 ``` ## Dependencies - [Phaser](https://phaser.io/) v4.2.1 - [Tailwind CSS](https://tailwindcss.com/) v3.4.17 - [Orbitron Font](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Orbitron) - [Share Tech Mono Font](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Share+Tech+Mono) ## Issues & Bug Reports Just fill an issue and describe it. We'll check it ASAP! or send an email to [info@spinhook.ir](mailto:info@spinhook.ir "info@spinhook.ir"). - Please complete the issue template
